connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.subtitle: Connect your services. Tokens are stored only in the system keychain of this computer.
connectors.keychain_off: No system keychain available: nothing can be connected (tokens are never stored in a file).
connectors.p_keychain: Tokens only in the system keychain; never in the database or in files.
connectors.p_scopes: Minimal permissions: read-only unless you enable write.
connectors.p_confirm: Every write (sending an email, posting a message…) waits for your confirmation here.
connectors.p_telemetry: No telemetry: the audit log stays on this computer.
connectors.legacy: You have {0} token connection(s) in the \u201cConnections\u201d view.
connectors.no_connectors: No connectors installed yet. The framework is ready; connectors (Google, Microsoft, Slack, Notion…) ship in upcoming releases.
connectors.client_id: Client ID of your OAuth app (BYOK)
connectors.token_hint: With a personal token you connect once and do not reconnect: the token does not expire on the provider\u2019s schedule.
connectors.token_advantage: It does not expire on the provider\u2019s schedule: connect once.
connectors.cred_expires_in: The credential renews while you use it: you would lose the connection after {0} days of inactivity.
connectors.cred_expires_soon: You would lose the connection after {0} days of inactivity: use it or reconnect.
connectors.cred_no_expiry: The credential does not expire: it lasts until you revoke it.
connectors.cred_token_no_expiry: Personal token: it does not expire, it lasts until you revoke it.
connectors.waiting: Waiting for authorization in the browser…
connectors.confirm_disconnect: Disconnect {0}? The token will be removed from the keychain.
connectors.byok_needed: You need your own client ID to connect.
connectors.mcp_hint: Tools are read-only by default. Tools that write or have side effects wait for your confirmation. What they return is treated as untrusted content.
connectors.mcp_confirm_remove: Remove MCP server {0}? Its secrets will be deleted from the keychain.
connectors.mcp_legacy: Variables saved by the old view: re-enter them here to move them to the keychain.
